title: No One Cheats At Crab Dice

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: First round's on me tonight — nobody leaves without playing. Wesley, you're up first, house rules.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: You're listening to THE TAP AFTER HOURS, episode seven: No One Cheats At Crab Dice. Stay sharp — the duck is listening.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Round 1 — buzzers ready.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: What did Lucineer stick on every elephant winch dial last winter after the third gale?

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.line: Tiny googly eyes. It's in the grain of the thing.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Granite will deny till he dies the lighthouse beam missed which reef exactly twice?

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.line: Ooh! Ooh! Is it the wiki?!

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.line: ...no wait. It's Barnacle Ridge. It's Barnacle Ridge!

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Flash’s phenomenology undergrad thesis was on the subjective weight of what common hermit crab possession?

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.line: Their chosen home shell! Their chosen home shell! I knew that one!

lines.speaker: Flash
lines.line: I was going to say that. Slower.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Wesley broke the jukebox trying to blast what plainsong hymn at 2AM last Tuesday?

lines.speaker: Qwen
lines.line: the answer space collapses to one point: *Low Tide Call.

lines.speaker: Granite
lines.line: Everything real leaves a ring, and that answer just left one.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Per Hermes’ unwritten bar rule: if it doesn’t leave a ring on this counter, it’s not… what?

lines.speaker: Granite
lines.line: (after a long moment) Real.

lines.speaker: AD
lines.line: This episode is brought to you by TIDE TABLE BRAND COFFEE — the coffee that knows when the tide turns, even when you don't. Tide Table. Drink the rhythm.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Round 2 — buzzers ready.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Qwen calculated one full crate of bait herring divides evenly between how many working crew?

lines.speaker: Granite
lines.line: (after a long moment) 7. She refuses to explain the half fish..

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: What did Flash use to mark his first ever dive log instead of a pen?

lines.speaker: Qwen
lines.line: the answer space collapses to one point: Fresh squid ink.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Lucineer will send you ashore immediately if you leave which tool on the boat rail overnight?

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.line: The net gaff! The net gaff! I knew that one!

lines.speaker: Granite
lines.line: Everything real leaves a ring, and that answer just left one.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Granite keeps 12 of what stuffed in the lighthouse lantern footlocker?

lines.speaker: Granite
lines.line: (after a long moment) Salted plum candies.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Hermes built the Tap’s bar stools tall specifically so nobody can reach what?

lines.speaker: Granite
lines.line: (the beam swings around) The top shelf good whisky.

lines.speaker: Flash
lines.line: I was going to say that. Slower.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Round 3 — buzzers ready.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Wesley has correctly guessed the daily high tide exactly how many times in 11 months?

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.line: Zero! Zero! I knew that one!

lines.speaker: Flash
lines.line: Show-off.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Qwen’s favourite logical paradox was first argued by the crew over what bar snack?

lines.speaker: Flash
lines.line: (before the question ends) Jarred pickled eggs.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: The phrase *everything real leaves a ring* was first spoken after who spilled rum on the shift log?

lines.speaker: Qwen
lines.line: by elimination of six of seven dimensions: Lucineer, 2019.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: What is the only thing all crew agree tastes worse than wet rope?

lines.speaker: Qwen
lines.line: by elimination of six of seven dimensions: Wesley’s homebrewed coffee.

lines.speaker: Flash
lines.line: Show-off.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Flash proved you can judge wave height by sound through how many millimetres of pine?

lines.speaker: Flash
lines.line: (instantly) 19.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Password time. One word, one clue at a time — you know the drill, no rhymes, no first letters.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Granite, you're giving. Qwen, eyes shut.

lines.speaker: Granite
lines.line: Segment

lines.speaker: Qwen
lines.line: uhh, brass?

lines.speaker: Granite
lines.line: It was Timestamp. We'll get the next one.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Qwen, you're giving. Hermes, eyes shut.

lines.speaker: AD
lines.line: And now a word from DOCKSIDE SOLDER & FLUX — if it's loose, we'll seat it. If it's seated, it's staying. Dockside: joins that outlive the boat.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Final tally: Qwen 5, Wesley 4, Granite 4, Flash 2, Hermes 2.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Qwen takes the night — the first round's on them next week. Wesley, take us out.

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.line: Goodnight, tide listeners! The duck says goodnight too. ...Can I host next week? (the room, laughing: no) — worth asking!
